[color=#ffff00][head=3]Section 4: Lore/Setting Rules[/head][/color]
[color=#a4885c]4.1[/color] Try to be creative by picking a believable and fitting name and/or surname.
- [color=#a4885c]4.1.1[/color] It's suggested to use a lore-accurate name for your race, although exceptions can exist when cultures clash. - [color=#a4885c]4.1.2[/color] Leeway is given to theatrical roles such as the clown, boxer, and mime; these roles are allowed stage names with some amount of freedom. - [color=#a4885c]4.1.3[/color] Being named after a popular figure is ok, but having the same name of a popular figure is not. - [color=#a4885c]4.1.4[/color] Avoid copyright names, such as GlaDOS or Megatron for borgs, Pennywise or The Joker for clowns, and so on.
[color=#a4885c]4.2[/color] You are not not allowed to have supernatural backgrounds, such as; secret demigods, beings from the future, or similar.
- [color=#a4885c]4.2.1[/color] Wizards and those apart of the wizards federation are an exception, however they cannot retain their magical powers while not antag - [color=#a4885c]4.2.2[/color] Changelings, Vampires, Werewolves, and Zombies are creatures of science, not magic. - [color=#a4885c]4.2.3[/color] If you have a strange concept and don't know if its allowed, you are always free to ask using F1 ahelp.
[color=#a4885c]4.3[/color] Don't use hate speech, racism, or bigoted comments. In the 26th century, society has moved passed petty bigotry.
- [color=#a4885c]4.3.1[/color] Distrust of borgs is exempt from this, due to their recent inclusion into sentient life and the existence of hostile rogue borgs. - [color=#a4885c]4.3.2[/color] Your character cannot be sexist, racist, speciest, ableist, lgbtphobic as it wouldn't make sense in an age where all are proven capable and treated equal.
